_why: Layout blocks must be valid JSON for every page: cool and exact. Sees reference images. Reads the whole book every call, so it needs a fast strong model: Gemma 4 31B took 20 minutes a call and timed out.
_help: Committed. Provider and model are usually set in the UI (⚙ Model). null = the .env default. API keys never go here: they're saved per provider in secrets/keys.json.
